newsitem.title: USA: Conversion, Octagon end merge plan.
newsitem.headline: Conversion, Octagon end merge plan.

text.p: Conversion Technologies International Inc said Tuesday it ended its merger plan with Octagon Inc by mutual agreement.

Octagon agreed under the terms of the merger termination to provide certain support services to Conversion on an interim basis, and Conversion hired certain Octogan employees that had been hired in anticipation of the closing of the merger.
In addition, Conversion agreed to forgive bridge loans it made to Octagon in payment for certain services prior to termination of the merger.
